about_the_game:
The woods are watching. And you're walking right in.

Step onto the trail as a journalist on a paid assignment to photograph a remote forest path. Your only connection to the outside world is a walkie talkie with your boyfriend, who's waiting in the RV nearby. But the deeper you venture, the more unnerving the trail becomes. Experience a series of increasingly disturbing events, from strange animal behavior to unsettling discoveries that hint at a sinister presence watching every step you take.

This demo offers the complete core gameplay loop and atmosphere of the full game, including the photography mechanics, immersive audio, and early narrative elements.

🔪 What's Included in the Demo vs. The Full Game

This demo provides an essential introduction to the game's world and mechanics:

• Exploration: The demo is limited to the first 10-15 minutes of gameplay and includes the initial section of the main forest path.

• Narrative: You will hear the opening segments of the walkie-talkie communication and discover the first few documents and tape recordings that set up the full game's mystery.

• Features: All key features, including first-person movement, camera mechanics, and inventory, are fully available.

The full game features an expanded environment with multiple new areas, the complete collection of collectible tapes and hidden lore, and a much longer narrative arc that culminates in an intense, unforgettable climax.

Will you be able to survive the horrors?

short_description: A first-person horror adventure where you explore a vast 1980s forest, take photographs of wildlife and mysterious phenomena, collect hidden tapes, and uncover dark secrets while tense audio and eerie events keep you on edge.
